targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (servico) servico, cloud, status FROM eventos_disponibilidade ORDER BY servico, ts DESC

SELECT protocolo, count(*) AS n, round(avg((fields->>'latencia_ms')::numeric),1) AS lat, round(avg((fields->>'pdr')::numeric),3) AS pdr, round(avg((fields->>'jitter_ms')::numeric),1) AS jitter, round(avg((fields->>'rssi')::numeric),1) AS rssi FROM metricas_iot WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND protocolo IN ('wifi','lorawan','6lowpan') GROUP BY protocolo ORDER BY protocolo

options.css: .wrap{font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:#e8eef7;padding:2px 6px} .hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0b3d91,#1f6feb);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 24px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4)} .htitle{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.3px} .hsub{font-size:13px;opacity:.9;margin-top:5px} .brand{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;opacity:.85;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px} .sec{font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.6px;opacity:.6;margin:20px 4px 12px} .grid{display:grid;gap:14px} .svc{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)} .proto{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)} .card{background:#12171f;border:1px solid #222b36;border-radius:16px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:transform .15s} .card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)} .cname{font-size:15px;font-weight:700} .cloud{font-size:11px;opacity:.55;margin-top:3px;letter-spacing:1px} .pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin-top:14px;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:22px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px} .up{background:rgba(63,185,80,.15);color:#3fb950;border:1px solid #2ea043} .down{background:rgba(248,81,73,.15);color:#f85149;border:1px solid #da3633} .dot{height:9px;width:9px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;margin-right:8px} .pcard{position:relative;overflow:hidden} .accent{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:5px;width:100%} .pname{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px} .metric{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:13px;margin-top:9px;opacity:.92} .metric b{font-weight:800;font-size:14px} .bar{height:8px;border-radius:5px;background:#222b36;margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden} .bar>span{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:5px} .muted{opacity:.5;font-size:11px;margin-top:14px} .foot{text-align:right;opacity:.4;font-size:11px;margin-top:18px}
